_README: TEMPLATE — copy to icmr-rda-2020.json and edit. This file contains NO clinical values.
Every number must be transcribed from the printed ICMR-NIN RDA/EAR 2020 tables.
Do not fill it in from memory, from another country's tables, or from a web search.
Run with:  npm run nutrition:import-references -- --manifest icmr-rda-2020.json --dry-run
The dry run reports every row it would reject and writes nothing. If ANY row is
invalid the real run writes nothing either — a half-imported requirement table
produces targets that look complete and are not.
See docs/nutrition-targets.md for what each rule type unblocks.
citation: REPLACE ME — e.g. 'ICMR-NIN RDA 2020, Table 4.2, p. 91'. Copied onto every rule so a reviewer can find the printed original.

rule_type: ACTIVITY_FACTOR — multiplier on resting energy; rule_key is the ActivityLevel (SEDENTARY, LIGHTLY_ACTIVE, MODERATELY_ACTIVE, VERY_ACTIVE)
GOAL_ENERGY_ADJUSTMENT — rule_key is the PrimaryGoal (WEIGHT_LOSS, WEIGHT_GAIN, ...); unit KCAL_PER_DAY or PERCENT_OF_ENERGY
FAT_ENERGY_PERCENT — unit PERCENT_OF_ENERGY; use value_type RANGE with value_min/value_max where the source states a band
MICRONUTRIENT_INTAKE — set nutrient, leave rule_key empty
value_type: RDA, EAR, AI, UL — use whichever word the publication itself uses. An AI shown as an RDA misrepresents the source's own confidence, and a UL is a ceiling rather than a target.
RANGE — fill value_min and value_max, leave value empty
unit: KCAL_PER_DAY, G_PER_DAY, MG_PER_DAY, UG_PER_DAY, G_PER_KG_PER_DAY, PERCENT_OF_ENERGY, FACTOR
A micronutrient's unit MUST match its entry in src/lib/nutrition/nutrients.ts.
Iron is stored in MG, so an iron requirement must be MG_PER_DAY. The importer rejects a mismatch rather than converting: between mg and ug a mistake is a factor of a thousand.
_vocabularies.sex: ANY, FEMALE, MALE. Write one row per sex where the table publishes different values.
_vocabularies.age: Whole years, inclusive on both ends. Leave empty for unbounded. A rule with age bounds is never applied to a client whose age is unknown.

_notPregnancyOrLactation: Leave physiological_state as NONE. The assessment model captures no physiological state yet, so PREGNANCY and LACTATION rows would import but never resolve. Add the assessment field first.
